product_summary: Website merillife.com (Meril group) Endo-Surgery division page lists: absorbable and non-absorbable surgical sutures (polyglactin 910, polyglecaprone 25, polydioxanone, polyamide, polypropylene, polyester, chromic catgut, polyglactin 910 with triclosan, polyglactin 910 fast, polyglycolic acid, barbed, steel), tissue sealants, absorbable haemostats, hernia repair meshes, intrauterine devices, and mechanical closure devices: MIRUS circular stapler, MIRUS linear stapler and reloads, MIRUS disposable skin stapler, MIRUS skin staple remover, MIRUS haemorrhoids stapler, MIRUS ligating clip. Group-level Orthopedics page lists TKR/THR systems (Freedom, Opulent, Destiknee, Latitud), trauma nails/plates/screws (PFRN, KET, Armar, Auric). Vascular Intervention division (stents, PTCA balloon catheters, liquid embolic Menox, Obtura hemostasis device) also exists at group level. No dedicated merilendo.com site resolved (DNS failure); no product page specific to the legal entity 'Meril Endo Surgery Private Limited' was found - the portfolio is presented under the Meril group brand.
role_hint: manufacturer (site states products are 'manufactured in-house' in Meril's own facilities; no trader/distributor signs found on the pages read)
comment: HS mapping: declared 300610 is CORROBORATED by the site - sutures, tissue sealants and absorbable haemostats are exactly the 3006.10 basket. Declared 901890 is CORROBORATED - staplers, reloads, skin staplers, staple removers and ligating clips are surgical instruments of 9018.90. Declared 902190 is only PARTIALLY corroborated: the Endo-Surgery portfolio includes IUDs and hernia meshes which can fall in 9021.90, but the site does not state HS codes, so the exact 6-digit line for meshes/IUDs remains 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Missing from the declaration: 902110 / 902131 (orthopaedic implants, nails, plates, screws, artificial joints) which are a major part of the Meril group portfolio, and 300691 (ostomy) if applicable - neither is evidenced for this specific legal entity, so flagged as group-level only. Industry misclassification: the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is WRONG - this is a medical device / surgical consumables manufacturer (MedTech). No customs line was available to me (registry/customs research out of scope per role), therefore all product lines above are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; only the product-to-HS mapping is verified against the company's own catalogue pages (merillife.com/our-products/endo-surgery, /our-products/orthopedics, /our-products). Per rule 3, the HS/industry mismatch does not reject the company - code should be corrected to the actual portfolio (300610 + 901890 confirmed; add 902110/902131 for orthopaedics if that entity ships them).
